Learning arc

Learning Journey

The portfolio follows a practical sequence: build visual grammar, improve statistical judgement, add interactivity, then move into specialised analytical domains.

01

Foundations

Exercises 1-2 establish layered graphics, annotation, theming, and composition.

02

Interactive and Animated Views

Exercises 3a-3b and 4a explore interaction, animation, and time-aware presentation.

03

Statistical Visual Analysis

Exercises 4b-5e move into uncertainty, funnel plots, correlation, heatmaps, parallel coordinates, and treemaps.

04

Network, Text, and Time

Exercises 7a, 7b, and 8 turn relational, textual, and temporal data into interpretable visual structures.

05

Spatial and Dashboard Methods

Exercises 9a-10 close the sequence with mapping, spatial analysis, and information dashboard design.
